Now, where was I? Ah. Yes. Here.
That was uncalled for. Also, it did not take. Hand me that spanner.
Don't look at the body, look at me. The body is old news.
Hm? Oh, him. One of me. There's always another one of me.
message.jaymospowers.tinkerer_echo.aside: ...Ow. Somebody, somewhere, just did something very rude to me.
Hold on. I've just been killed. No, not here. Carry on.
Tch. There goes another one. They never learn, and neither do I.
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.turned: Ask about the androids that turned
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.turned.1: "Los Perrito's sweepers? Shoddy copies of shoddy copies. Whoever wrote that city's orders should be ashamed. Not me. I'd have done it properly."
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.turned.2: "Turned? Machines don't turn. Somebody told them to. Who? How should I know who? Pass me that wrench."
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.turned.3: "A bug, they say. A bug! Every machine has a bug, it's what makes it interesting. Next question."
